items.t: Brakes may briefly lose pressure at low speed (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer

items.t: Parking brake may apply or fail from harness damage (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer

items.t: Right front lower control arm may crack (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer

items.t: Rear drive motor wiring may short, loss of power (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer
Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer

items.t: Early software faults: dead screens, charging and battery warnings
items.job: Reprogram several control modules under GM customer satisfaction program
items.note: GM program N232428190 reprograms modules including the battery energy control module, brake module and gateway; GM Authority says it takes certified techs just over an hour. Done free at a Chevrolet dealer.

items.t: Service High Voltage message with dead 12-volt battery
items.job: Battery control module software update and reset
items.note: Hours are GM warranty labor times. Covered by GM warranty on most cars; a 12-volt battery may need recharging.

items.t: Service High Voltage warning from battery software codes
items.job: Battery control module programming and reset
items.note: Hours combine GM labor times for battery data retrieval, programming and reset. Normally covered by warranty.

items.t: No cabin heat with Service High Voltage warning
items.note: Software fix under warranty; a failed thermal system part would cost more but is covered by the EV component warranty.

items.t: Unable to charge or DC fast charging unavailable
items.job: Diagnose code P2980 and update software
items.note: 1.0 hour is GM labor time. A real insulation fault needs further repair.

items.t: Touchscreen or gauge display goes black or reboots
items.job: Radio software update or reset, check display cables
items.note: GM says not to replace the radio for most of these concerns.

items.t: False low 12-volt battery alerts from OnStar
items.note: No repair beyond the software; normally done free under warranty.

items.t: Wiring harness rubs on front axle, charging limited to 26%
items.job: Diagnose Service High Voltage message and inspect A/C compressor harness
items.note: Diagnosis only: 0.3 hour is GM labor time from bulletin PIC6609. Splicing the chafed wires and rerouting the harness is added at GM standard published time, which depends on how many wires are damaged. Normally covered by GM warranty on 2025 models.

items.t: Service Brake System warning and loss of brake assist
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder with electronic brake booster (eBoost)
items.note: Parts are the GM master cylinder and booster assembly (85020876, now 85850705), online sale price to list price. Hours are GM labor time for the 2024 Blazer EV (4.7) plus the 0.2-hour hydraulics test from GM program N252521980. On 2024 models GM first reprograms the brake module free under that program (about 0.5 hour) and replaces the unit only if fault codes remain. Normally covered by warranty.
